note: Set A binds every value to the correct mission concept and property (e.g., Lynx focal length 10 m, HabEx starshade 52 m, LUVOIR-A/B diameters and instrument counts) with supporting quotes, though it contains several duplicate claims. Set B has many misbound or vague claims where the entity is dropped or wrong — 'on-axis telescope', 'off-axis telescope', 'spacecraft', 'starshade', and 'grazing incidence mirror assembly' are used instead of LUVOIR-A/B, HabEx and Lynx, and it wrongly assigns the three science instruments to the mirror assembly and calls the 10 m focal length a generic 'dimension'. Set B also has garbled/truncated quotes and redundant repeats. Set A is clearly more faithful despite its duplication.
